checkpoint_review: I have re-evaluated all checkpoints independently. The Router's verdicts were largely correct, but I initially accepted the 'Legs and feet are feathered' checkpoint too readily. Upon closer inspection of the image and the topology mask, the feet are almost entirely obscured by snow and blur; while feathering is visible on the upper leg (tarsus), the actual feet/toes are not clearly distinguishable as feathered. However, given the species context and visible upper-leg plumage, this is a minor ambiguity rather than a failure. All other checkpoints remain valid with strong visual confirmation.
authenticity_review: My initial authenticity score of 3.72 was too lenient given the severity of the white-on-white artifact. The perceptual quality auditor flagged 'slight blur' (severity 0.2), but the Router identified a more critical texture anomaly in the undertail coverts (severity 2). The white feathers lack any strand-level detail and appear as a smooth, plastic-like mass merging with the snow—this is a classic AI generation failure in high-contrast boundaries. Combined with the indistinct feet/ground interface, these are not merely 'minor textural issues' but significant fidelity problems that reduce realism. The mask confidence (0.98) confirms structural coherence but does not excuse the textural melting. I am lowering the authenticity score to reflect this compounded defect.
alignment_reasoning: All 8 testable checkpoints passed.
